extension.construction: replace one of the two non-root generators by itself plus one signed ambient root

completeness_boundary.complete: All signed ambient-root mutations of the two stored control embeddings in the declared mutable rows are tested, saturated, and filtered exactly.
completeness_boundary.heuristic: This does not enumerate every rank-four-to-seven root subsystem, every short-glue extension, or every primitive rank-seven Niemeier auxiliary below the determinant bound. It is a first deterministic foundry shell, not a bounded-classification theorem.
